<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy tightening:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% and shifted to a calibrated tightening stance, with analysts projecting a terminal rate reaching 6.0%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxPNTNKRC1TMHZWQmI0RmY0RXoxUk10YWl0LVZCeTVFNnM4VllkQkxTZ2JjblMyWVRoZzZEZmVPRngzTFVSQlRXZEx5WHB2SGpYV05wZ0x4bUFrdG5zS1h2UkRqclZGUkhZX1dXR01LenVhcEJjb1ktUXdqR3pmOTF4TnFwWnlhV0hsdUcwTExuWUtYZEdDT255eXJHR1JJb2M2VC1WTUVzelA2NHZsNmVkTXZyN01YUE1wZnR4S1ZnVFo5UGZuLVE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPTllLMmNLTFlvSlA4THZQUkZpM2Vxc2hER2pzOFVEY3RnSjVmTFRhaW10V0xzLWJ4dm9wenF3QzY4cXEyTlJPSjBzbVZpN0MzN1hmaHZadzVKOVFMRmdpaTRDRldFYVliU25OSjF4U1l2bk12c3FPTUFXQnRGcXBfNlM2Y2pjTHZGSzBzb2FRVDNvWTRtZmRJaUNB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
